scope: One new qualification workflow, one exact-diff audit tool, a predeclared STAFF-only fixture and metadata validation; no OWNER/ADMIN repetition and no product mutation.
source_provenance: Public pinned repository audit tool plus literal synthetic fixture/metadata; initial captured report used only for exact hash/error reference. No raw logs, credentials, external user data or extraneous local files are included.
transport: Root publishes the exact locally reviewed tree on this own audit branch through the authenticated connector and normal review. No alternate action if rejected.
runtime: Local disposable CI PostgreSQL/Auth/browser stack only. No hosted/production credentials or endpoints.
